description: Validate every detail and create a Shopify checkout for one personalised poster with all the details attached. Returns checkout_url. Nothing is charged: open checkout_url for the user to review the order and pay on GiftsToPrint's own checkout. Before calling, read the details back to the user, including the photo_url so they can check it is the right photo, and confirm they understand they will receive a digital file to print (set confirm_digital_file to true). If a field is wrong, the error lists every problem at once so you can fix them in one go.

email.description: The buyer's email. The download link is sent here.

buyer_country.description: Optional ISO country code, so checkout opens in the buyer's currency.

confirm_digital_file.description: Must be true: the buyer understands the poster is a digital file to print, not a physical print.

instructions.description: Optional note to the designers, e.g. how to crop the photo.

personalisation.description: The fields from get_poster_form, keyed by their id (e.g. recipient_first_name, birth_day, birth_month).

turnaround.description: standard: ready the next working day, order Mon-Fri. rush_weekday: ready within 12 hours, order Mon-Fri. rush_weekend: ready within 24 hours, order Sat or Sun.

name: create_poster_checkout
title: Create the personalised checkout
